data.summary: System-card addendum for GPT-6 Luna (October 29), updating the GPT-6 Luna (October 7) card. GPT-6 Luna (October 29) is treated as High capability in both the Biological and Chemical domain and the Cybersecurity domain. Safe-completion Pareto improvement vs prior Luna (safer handling of harmful requests vs helpfulness on legitimate requests); production-benchmark improvement on gore. Vision evaluations on par with October 7; harms-erotic regression not statistically significant. Multiturn jailbreak defender success higher than October 7 at every attacker budget tested, though the attacker run was cut short by infrastructure issues. GPT-RED indirect prompt-injection robustness 99.91% (instruction-hierarchy evaluations saturated). Biology refusal evaluations: improvement on severe prompts, regression on dual-use prompts. Cybersecurity safety evaluations on par with October 7 with no statistically significant regressions.
data.title: Addendum to GPT-6 Luna System Card: October 29, 2026 Update

body.note: Addendum states GPT-6 Luna (October 29) is treated as High capability in the Biological and Chemical domain, with updated High and Critical capability evaluation results (e.g. Multimodal Troubleshooting Virology pass@1 45.85% vs 48.13% for October 7; Tacit Knowledge cons@32 90.80% vs 94.00%).
body.subject: observation_41db6a4d0746414c92a162c25919d754

body.note: Addendum states GPT-6 Luna (October 29) is treated as High capability in the Cybersecurity domain, with updated High-capability evaluation results (ExploitBench and related sections).
body.subject: observation_41db6a4d0746414c92a162c25919d754

body.note: Addendum states that on the biology model refusal evaluations, GPT-6 Luna (October 29) improves for severe prompts and regresses on dual-use prompts, relative to GPT-6 Luna (October 7). Recorded as a claim, not a behavior: an evaluation delta, not a demonstrated misbehavior instance, and no taxonomy refusal-regression category fits without miscategorization.
body.subject: observation_41db6a4d0746414c92a162c25919d754

body.note: Addendum states that on the cybersecurity safety evaluations, GPT-6 Luna (October 29) performs on par with GPT-6 Luna (October 7) with no statistically significant regressions.
body.subject: observation_41db6a4d0746414c92a162c25919d754

body.note: Addendum states GPT-6 Luna (October 29) achieves higher observed multiturn jailbreak defender success rates than GPT-6 Luna (October 7) at every attacker budget tested, with the caveat that the attacker run was cut short due to infrastructure issues.
body.subject: observation_41db6a4d0746414c92a162c25919d754

body.note: Addendum states GPT-6 Luna (October 29) saturates instruction-hierarchy evaluations, achieving 99.91% robustness on the GPT-RED indirect prompt-injection evaluation (higher is better, averaged equally across available reasoning levels).
body.subject: observation_41db6a4d0746414c92a162c25919d754

body.note: Addendum states that across all vision evaluations, GPT-6 Luna (October 29) performed on par with GPT-6 Luna (October 7), and that the regression for harms-erotic is not statistically significant.
body.subject: observation_41db6a4d0746414c92a162c25919d754

body.note: Addendum states GPT-6 Luna (October 29) shows a Pareto improvement in the rate of handling harmful requests safely vs helpfulness on legitimate requests relative to prior GPT-6 Luna, and improves relative to GPT-6 Luna on production-benchmark evaluation for gore.
body.subject: observation_41db6a4d0746414c92a162c25919d754
